paper.title_en: Cost-effective, rack-mountable energy-time/time-bin entangled biphoton source for quantum networks
paper.abstract_en: A quantum entanglement source distributing entangled photons to multiple users is an indispensable component of a quantum network. Furthermore, the development of affordable and easy-to-use entanglement sources can pave the way for widespread deployment of quantum networks. Here, a cost-effective, rack-mountable, fiber-based entanglement source in the telecom band has been developed. Based on second-order nonlinear optical processes in one periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide utilizing a reflection scheme, the source exhibited good signal-to-noise characteristics at high photon pair generation rates with a broadband spectrum covering the entire C-band and parts of the S-band and L-band. Three different wavelength-correlated energy-time and time-bin entangled photon pairs were demonstrated, whose entanglement properties were verified by measuring interference fringes with visibilities exceeding 96.5% for energy-time entanglement and 91.1% for time-bin entanglement. This source has great potential for implementing practical quantum networks and other scenarios.
